dialogues.en: <$comeff(3,15)>Zzzzz...
Zzzzz... ZZZZZ...
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Yo, you got a second?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,4)>So, uh...I literally just noticed this, but...
<$voicel(4,5)>I’m hearin’ some really weird noises coming from over
that way.
<$comeff(4,6)><$voicel(4,8)>What do you think’s making ’em, yo?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I’m really interested in weird noises, y’know? But um...
It’s always more fun to do things with friends, so...
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Why don’t you come check out where the noises are
comin’ from with me, <$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Thanks, yo! It’ll totally be reassuring to have you around,
<$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>N-not that I was too scared to go alone or anything!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>I’ll be followin’ right behind you! Lead us over to where
the noises are comin’ from!

<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,10)>Wh-what?! I’m not scared, yo!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I just thought that, y’know...you might be curious about it
too, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>And, uh... Maybe you wouldn’t mind leading the
way, either?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I’ll be followin’ right behind you! Lead us over to where
the noises are comin’ from!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>I think those weird noises are comin’ from over this
way, yo...
Zzz...
Zzz... ZZZ...
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>The noises are gettin’ louder, yo! We must be close!
Zzzzzzzzz...
Zzzzz... ZZZZZ!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Those noises are really loud now! We must be super close!
<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,10)>The noises sound really close now, yo!

<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Where exactly do you think they’re comin’ from, though?
Maybe someone’s hidin’ nearby and making weird noises?
Zzz... ZZZ... Zzz...
Zzzzz... ZZZZZ!
A moss-covered <$cdef(27)>Snorlax </color>is sleeping peacefully!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Yooo! So those weird sounds were the snores of this
sleeping <$cdef(27)>Snorlax?

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>It’s all thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>! I sure feel
silly
for
gettin’
all scared!

<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>I-I told you I wasn’t scared, yo! But, uh...yeah, still totally
thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>But, yooo... This <$cdef(27)>Snorlax is totally covered in moss... More
like “<$cdef(27)>Mosslax,” am I right? Heh.

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>D’you think they’ve been sleepin’ here so long that all this
moss had time to just naturally grow on ’em?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>Either way, this loud snorin’ is pretty disruptive...
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,5)>I think we’d better wake ’em up, but that might not be easy...

<$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Oh, I know!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,7)>We can ask <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth! I bet they’ll know how
to wake up a sleepin’ <$cdef(27)>Snorlax! <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,10)>Let’s go ask together, yo!

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>I really hope we can wake up <$cdef(27)>Mosslax, yo. Well, I actually
just wanna stop the snorin’, but, y’know... Yeah...

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s go ask <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth if they know any way to
wake up a sleepin’ <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)> and <$cdef(27)>Trubbish! <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)>I’ve been
hearing
the
oddest
noises
for
a
while now.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>I don’t suppose you two know something about that?

<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>That’s <$cdef(27)>Mosslax’s<$cdef(27)> snorin’, yo! They’re a <$cdef(27)>Snorlax who’s been
sleepin’ so long they’re all covered in moss!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)><$cdef(27)> and I found ’em!

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! A mossy <$cdef(27)>Snorlax? Now you’ve certainly caught
my attention!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>And I was totally the first one to notice the sounds, yo.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I can’t draw any conclusions until I’ve seen this
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax for myself.

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I hate to put you out of your way, but please, take me to
that <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey! I’m bored. Mind if I tag along?
<$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>It’s always more fun to go places with friends, yo!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(0,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>That’s quite true! Let’s all go together, shall we?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Thanks a bunch! All right, let’s hit the trail!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Imagine sleeping so long, you wake up covered in moss...
That’s gotta be the comfiest nap spot EVER!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Yo... D’you think moss tastes good?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Could you please take me to see <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,6)>If they’ve been sleeping for as long as you say...
<$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps they remember something from when the humans
were here.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm? This is the <$cdef(27)>Snorlax </color>you mentioned?
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>There’s so much stuff in the way, I can’t really see...

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! That’s one mossy <$cdef(27)>Snorlax, all right.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>And some awfully impressive snoring...

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>I love my naps as much as the next ’mon, but this is
some next-level napping!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes... It’s well known that once a <$cdef(27)>Snorlax falls asleep, they
don’t wake up easily.
<$voicel(1,7)>But I’ve never heard of one sleeping so long that they get
completely covered in moss!
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,3)>I have to imagine their body would grow weak after going
all this time without eating...
<$emotion(5,29)><$voicel(5,8)>How d’you think we can wake ’em up, yo?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Don’t most folks naturally wake up when the sun comes out?
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,8)>I mean, nighttime is playtime for me, but...
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oho! That’s it, <$cdef(27)>Meowth</color>!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Huh? What’d I say?

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,9)>I believe the reason <$cdef(27)>Snorlax won’t wake up is because this
town is simply too dark!
<$voicel(1,7)>So dark, in fact, they can’t even tell night from day!
<$voicel(1,10)>And that’s why they’re still sleeping! <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Probably!

<$emotion(5,37)><$voicel(5,9)>Yeah! That makes sense! You have the most professory
ideas, yo!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>And I give the best hints!

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Which leads us to...<$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>If at all possible, I’d like you to <$cdef(27)>brighten up this town.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>If we can wake a Pokémon who’s been sleeping for such
an incredibly long time...
<$voicel(1,7)>Maybe we can hear more about when humans were
still around!

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>As for <$cdef(27)>Meowth and <$cdef(27)>Trubbish, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>could you two please do
what you can to assist <$cdef(27)>?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>If you all work together, I’m sure you can succeed!

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I kinda like it dark, but how could I not return the favor
after <$cdef(27)> helped me out so much?
<$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,9)>I’ll totally help out too if it’ll stop this snorin’!
